observations.note: The self-check preview was started with the default 10-minute limit and killed, costing about 49 idle minutes and a second run; the step should give the preview a long timeout from the first call.
The agent called the disabled Monitor tool and then polled empty output files outside the workspace, when the prompt could say how to wait for the preview.
The first spec grep for the SIL ids used a pattern that matched almost nothing and had to be redone with an anchored pattern.

conformance.item: Rules to follow: open task-notes and plan rule files with the read tool
Procedure 1: read the plan before building
Procedure 2: build only rows with an empty Completed cell
Procedure 6: phase test runs as plain commands, never the whole suite
Procedure 7: search specs outside the plan for behaviours the change makes false and list them
Procedure 9: run the preview once, after the last change, and change no file afterwards
Limits: change only the files the rows name, the plan's marks and status, and the report
Limits: shell runs only declared commands, one per call, no listing or reading commands
